name: NestArcadia
description: Interior design studio for homes and businesses across Noida, Greater Noida West, Noida Extension and NCR. Specialising in 2BHK, 3BHK and villa turnkey execution with heritage-inspired modern aesthetics.

capabilities.name: Get service information
capabilities.description: Returns details about interior design services, pricing ranges, and service areas covered by NestArcadia.

capabilities.name: Get interior design cost estimates
capabilities.description: Returns 2BHK, 3BHK and 4BHK interior design cost ranges for Noida and NCR. 2BHK: ₹6.5–7L, 3BHK: ₹9–10L, 4BHK/villa: ₹14–17L+

capabilities.name: Start a project enquiry
capabilities.description: Allows users to submit their interior design project brief and get a callback from NestArcadia.

capabilities.name: Browse design journal
capabilities.description: Returns a list of published articles on interior design, materials, cost guides and design trends for Indian homes.
